section.content: The utility model belongs to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a lithium ion battery, compared with the prior art, the lithium ion battery provided by the utility model has a multi-layer structure welding section, each layer of welding section is welded with a steel shell together in a corresponding position, so that a melting layer formed after welding is thickened, the corresponding shear strength and tensile strength are effectively improved, when a battery cell shakes or twists in the steel shell, the multi-layer welding section can share shear force, thereby reducing the load of the welding section directly welded with the steel shell, effectively avoiding the direct perforation and desoldering of the melting layer, even if the perforation and desoldering is carried out at first in the welding section far away from the steel shell, the welding section directly welded with the steel shell can also be connected with the steel shell, and can play a role of spring buffering when the battery falls, and effectively filtering a part of impact, thereby improving the impact resistance of the battery.

本实用新型属于电池技术领域，具体为一种锂离子电池，与现有技术相比，本实用新型提供的锂离子电池具有多层结构的焊接段，各层焊接段在对应的位置与钢壳熔接在一起，因此使焊接后形成的熔融层变厚，其相应的抗剪切强度和抗拉强度也得到有效的提高，当电芯在钢壳内部发生晃动或扭转时，多层的焊接段会分担剪切力，从而减轻直接与钢壳熔接的焊接段的负荷，有效地避免熔融层直接穿孔脱焊，即使穿孔脱焊也是远离钢壳的焊接段先发生脱离，直接与钢壳熔接的焊接段还能保持与钢壳连接，并且可以起到类似弹簧缓冲的效果，在电池跌落时可起到弹簧缓冲的作用，有效地过滤掉一部分的冲击，从而提升电池的抗冲击能力。

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model belongs to the technical field of batteries, and particularly relates to a lithium ion battery.

Background

A coiled core lithium ion battery comprises a steel shell and a battery core, wherein a positive tab and a negative tab are led out of the battery core, when the battery core is assembled in the prior art, as shown in figure 1, the battery core 2 is firstly arranged in the steel shell 1, then the tail end of the led-out negative tab 22 is directly welded on the inner wall of the bottom side of the steel shell 1 by resistance heat generated when current passes through a conductor through resistance welding, so that the battery core 2 is fixed on the steel shell 1, but as the resistance welding belongs to spot welding, a round point-shaped welding point can be formed between the welded negative tab and the inner wall of the bottom side of the steel shell, when the battery core shakes in the use or transportation process, the battery core can generate displacement relative to the steel shell, the welding point is subjected to shearing force, when the welding point is repeatedly subjected to shearing force or subjected to overlarge shearing force, the negative tab is easily broken to cause the welding to be separated from the steel shell, and when the separation welding occurs, the internal resistance of the battery can be sharply increased, so that the battery cannot be normally used.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims to overcome the defect that the welding point of a negative electrode lug and a steel shell of the conventional battery cell is not firm and is easy to be influenced by shearing force to cause desoldering, and provides a lithium ion battery which improves the thickness of the welding point by arranging a welding section with a multilayer structure to be welded with the steel shell to enhance the shearing strength and the tensile strength.

In order to solve the technical problems, the utility model adopts the following technical scheme:

the utility model provides a lithium ion battery, includes the box hat and locates electric core in the box hat, electric core includes positive plate, negative pole piece, locates positive plate with diaphragm between the negative pole piece, locate the positive lug of positive plate upside and locating negative pole piece downside negative pole ear, negative pole ear end is equipped with at least two-layer range upon range of welding section, between each layer welding section and the welding section of downside with the box hat bottom side inner wall fuses integratively each other through the welding in predetermined position.

Compared with the prior art, the lithium ion battery provided by the utility model has the welding sections with the multilayer structure, each welding section is welded with the steel shell at the corresponding position, so that a melting layer formed after welding is thickened, the corresponding shear strength and tensile strength are effectively improved, when the battery core shakes or twists in the steel shell, the multilayer welding sections can share the shear force, the load of the welding section directly welded with the steel shell is reduced, perforation and desoldering of the melting layer are effectively avoided, even if the perforation and desoldering are carried out at first by the welding section far away from the steel shell, the welding section directly welded with the steel shell can be still connected with the steel shell, the effect similar to spring buffering can be achieved, the effect of spring buffering can be achieved when the battery falls, part of impact can be effectively filtered, and the impact resistance of the battery is improved.

Furthermore, the two adjacent welding sections are in arc transitional connection, and the arc transitional connection can further improve the buffering effect of the welding sections.

Furthermore, welding sites are arranged in the middle of each layer of welding sections, and the welding sections among the welding sections of each layer and on the lowest side are welded with the inner wall of the bottom side of the steel shell at the welding sites; or welding sites are arranged at the positions, close to the edges, of the welding sections of each layer, and the welding sections among the welding sections of each layer and at the lowest side are welded with the inner wall of the bottom side of the steel shell at the welding sites.

Furthermore, the welding sections comprise main connecting sections close to the inner wall of the bottom side of the steel shell and a plurality of auxiliary connecting sections located above the main connecting sections, the auxiliary connecting sections are bent downwards at the welding positions, and the bending mode can shorten the distance between the welding sections so as to ensure that the welding sections can be effectively welded.

Furthermore, the welding section is welded at the central position of the inner wall of the bottom side of the steel shell in a welding mode.

Furthermore, the tail end of the negative electrode lug is bent to form at least two layers of longitudinally extending, circuitous and tortuous welding sections, the welding sections formed by bending are integrated with the negative electrode lug into a whole, and the forming mode is simple in process, stable in connection and strong in damping effect.

Furthermore, the welding section is set to be two-layer or three-layer, and the two-layer or three-layer arrangement can avoid the increase of consumptive material when guaranteeing to increase shear strength and tensile strength, also is favorable to saving the space between electric core and the box hat.

Further, the lithium ion battery is a roll core battery, the battery core is formed by winding a positive plate, a diaphragm and a negative plate which are stacked, and the negative tab is connected to the region of the negative plate, which is positioned on the outer ring of the battery core; or the negative electrode tab is connected to the region of the negative electrode sheet, which is positioned in the inner ring of the battery core; or the negative electrode tab is connected to the region of the negative electrode plate between the outer ring and the inner ring of the battery core.

Furthermore, in order to improve the damping effect, the negative electrode tabs are obliquely arranged relative to the negative electrode plates, and the direct impact on the battery when the battery falls can be reduced by the oblique arrangement mode of the electrode tabs.

Drawings

Fig. 1 is a schematic structural diagram of a welding mode of a conventional battery cell and a steel shell;

fig. 2 is a schematic structural diagram 1 of a welding mode of a battery cell and a steel shell according to the present invention, in which a negative electrode tab is led out from a region of a negative electrode sheet located at an inner ring of the battery cell;

fig. 3 is a schematic structural diagram 2 of a welding mode of a battery cell and a steel shell according to the present invention, in which a negative electrode tab is led out from a region of a negative electrode sheet located at an outer ring of the battery cell;

fig. 4 is a schematic structural diagram 3 of a welding mode of a battery cell and a steel shell according to the utility model, wherein a negative electrode tab is led out from a region of a negative electrode sheet between an outer ring and an inner ring of the battery cell;

fig. 5 is a schematic diagram of welding of the battery core and the steel shell according to the utility model.

Detailed Description

The following describes embodiments of the present invention with reference to the drawings. In the description of the present invention, it should be noted that the terms "upper", "lower", "inner", "outer", end ", and the like indicate orientations or positional relationships based on those shown in the drawings, and are only for convenience of description and simplicity of description, but do not indicate or imply that the referred device or element must have a specific orientation, be constructed in a specific orientation, and be operated, and thus, should not be construed as limiting the present invention.

Referring to fig. 2 to 5, the present embodiment provides a lithium ion battery, especially a core lithium ion battery, including a steel case 1 and a battery cell 2 disposed in the steel case 1, where the battery cell 2 is formed by winding a stacked positive plate, a stacked diaphragm (not shown in the positive plate and the stacked diaphragm), and a negative plate 21, an upper end of the positive plate extends out of a positive tab (not shown in the positive tab), and a lower end of the negative plate 21 extends out of a negative tab 22, where, as shown in fig. 3, the negative tab 22 may be led out from an area of the negative plate 21 located at an outer ring of the battery cell 2, as shown in fig. 2, or from an area of the negative plate 21 located at an inner ring of the battery cell 2, as shown in fig. 4, or from an area of the negative plate 21 located between the outer ring and the inner ring of the battery cell 2.

Referring to fig. 2 to 5, the end of the negative tab 22 is provided with at least two layers of welding segments 3, and the welding segments 3 between the welding segments 3 and on the lowest side and the inner wall of the bottom side of the steel can 1 are welded together at predetermined positions, so as to achieve the connection between the battery cell 2 and the steel can 1, as shown in fig. 5, in a specific embodiment, the welding segments 3 and the steel can 1 are welded together by contacting the welding pins 100 with the inner wall of the bottom side of the steel can 1 and the welding segments 3, respectively, and contacting the welding pins 100 with resistance heat generated by the conductor.

Compared with the prior art, the lithium ion battery provided by the utility model has the welding sections 3 with a multilayer structure, and the welding sections 3 of all layers are welded with the steel shell 1 at corresponding positions, so that a melting layer formed after welding is thickened, the corresponding shear strength and tensile strength are effectively improved, when the battery cell 2 shakes or twists in the steel shell 1, the multilayer welding sections 3 can share the shear force, thereby reducing the load of the welding section 3 directly welded with the steel shell 1, effectively avoiding the direct perforation and desoldering of the melting layer, even if the perforation is detached, the welding section 3 far away from the steel shell 1 is detached first, the welding section 3 directly welded with the steel shell 1 can be still connected with the steel shell 1, and can play the effect of similar spring buffering, can play the effect of spring buffering when the battery falls, filter partial impact effectively to promote the shock resistance of battery.

Referring to fig. 2 to 5, in a specific embodiment, the welding section 3 is formed by bending the end of the negative electrode tab 22 at least once, as shown in fig. 3, at least two continuous welding sections 3 are formed to extend longitudinally and to be tortuous, and the welding section 3 integrally formed with the negative electrode tab 22 has the advantages of simple forming process, stable connection and strong damping effect.

In a specific embodiment, as shown in fig. 2, the welding section 3 is preferably set to two layers, as shown in fig. 3, the welding section 3 is preferably set to three layers, and the two or three layers can avoid the increase of consumables while ensuring the increase of the shear strength and the tensile strength, and also facilitate the saving of the space between the battery core 2 and the steel shell 1.

Referring to fig. 2 and 3, welding sites a are arranged in the middle of each layer of welding segments 3, the welding segments 3 between each layer of welding segments 3 and on the lowest side are welded with the inner wall of the bottom side of the steel shell 1 at the welding sites a, and the center of gravity of the cell 2 can be more stable by arranging the welding sites a in the middle of the welding segments 3; of course, the welding point a may be provided at a position of the welding segment 3 near the edge thereof.

Referring to fig. 3, the welding segments 3 include a main connecting segment 3a near the inner wall of the bottom side of the steel shell 1, and a plurality of auxiliary connecting segments 3b located above the main connecting segment 3a, and the auxiliary connecting segments 3b are bent toward the lower side 3a at the welding points a, and the bending is performed in a manner that the distance between the welding segments 3 is shortened, so as to ensure that the welding segments 3 can be welded together effectively.

Referring to fig. 2 to 4, the welding segment 3 is welded to the bottom inner wall of the steel shell 1 at the center.

Referring to fig. 2 to 4, two adjacent welding sections 3 are in arc transition connection, and the arc transition connection can further enhance the buffering effect of the welding sections 3.

Referring to fig. 2 to 4, as a modified solution, in order to improve the shock absorption effect, the negative electrode tab 22 is obliquely arranged relative to the negative electrode sheet 21, and the oblique arrangement of the tab can reduce the impact directly received when the battery falls.

Variations and modifications to the above-described embodiments may occur to those skilled in the art, which fall within the scope and spirit of the above description. Therefore, the present invention is not limited to the specific embodiments disclosed and described above, and some modifications and variations of the present invention should fall within the scope of the claims of the present invention. Furthermore, although specific terms are employed herein, they are used in a generic and descriptive sense only and not for purposes of limitation.
